subject.title: [Feature]: Make detached longwork final delivery ownership explicit

question: Should this issue remain the canonical thread for detached longwork final-delivery ownership, and should the owner invariant live in subagent completion delivery state, source-delivery planning, or a narrower channel-specific recovery substrate?
rationale: Current main has partial routing and durable-delivery mechanisms, but choosing a model-facing/plugin-facing owner contract changes public API, persisted state, and channel delivery semantics; automation cannot safely pick that product boundary.

options.title: Keep this issue canonical and extend subagent delivery state
options.body: Use the existing subagent completion delivery state plus source-delivery plan as the substrate, then recut smaller PRs with docs, compatibility defaults, and live transport proof.

options.title: Move the invariant to a narrower delivery-recovery issue
options.body: Close or retarget this issue only after maintainers name a more specific canonical issue for final-delivery obligations and preserve this issue’s Discord migration context there.

options.title: Reject a core owner-mode API for now
options.body: Require orchestration/plugin code to own bridge behavior explicitly and keep core limited to current requester-key routing plus duplicate-delivery bug fixes.

recommendation.title: Keep this issue canonical and extend subagent delivery state
recommendation.body: Use the existing subagent completion delivery state plus source-delivery plan as the substrate, then recut smaller PRs with docs, compatibility defaults, and live transport proof.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent subagent delivery-state and docs history plus merge/review activity make this the best available routing candidate for the product/API decision.
